state:
**Goal `ci-green` is met locally, and waits on one push.** The driver's sweep after the last DONE
found ThreadSanitizer red. The cause was not a race: the checkout moved from `D:\mwl` to `E:\mwl`,
and `/var/tmp/nvs-tsan` still held test binaries with `/mnt/d/mwl` compiled in. `tools/tsan.sh` and
`tools/leak-check.sh` now source `tools/target-checkout.sh`, which cleans a target directory another
checkout built. `bash tools/tsan.sh` prints `tsan: clean` from the rebuilt directory. That commit
touches `tools/`, which `bun nv ci-green` does not count as bookkeeping (`tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts:25`),
so the goal needs `git push origin main` and a green `ci.yml` run for it.

The warm-start check (`bench --warm-start --max-work-ms 6`) passes on an idle machine at 5.9 ms. Its
red in the sweep is load: under a concurrent tsan build the bench declines to measure.

next.title: the run exists, and it is this commit's

items.text: **`bun nv ci-green` exits 0 once the user pushes `HEAD`** — `rule:testing/ci-lanes`; the check is `tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts:25`. A session only confirms the run, and never pushes.

backlog: The warm-start check runs with 0.1 ms of margin on an idle machine and fails when the sweep overlaps it with a build — `tools/nv/cmd/bench.ts`, not checked whether the sweep can order it apart.
